value.rationale: A natural geometric phase boundary arises when a circle arc becomes just long enough to contain equilateral triangles. Varying its length on the unique quadratic scale sqrt(epsilon) requires balancing two corner constraints with interior angular displacement. The resulting explicit nontrivial profile interpolates otherwise incompatible fixed-arc tail exponents, has an exact change to a linear branch, and supplies a conditional uniform shape law on a quadratic region. This critical-window classification is a structural, nonroutine geometric-probability invariant, not a renaming or table recomputation.
